description: This Java class defines configuration properties for an authentication server, including resource paths and signing configurations, as part of the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth.impl package.

classes.name: AuthenticationServerConfigProperties
classes.description: A class holding configuration properties for the authentication server, including signing settings and permissions resource.

methods.name: getSigning
methods.description: Returns the signing configuration properties used for token creation.

methods.name: getValidation
methods.description: Returns the same signing properties used for token validation.

methods.name: getPermissionsPath
methods.description: Retrieves the resource location for authorization rules, defaulting to 'permissions.json' on the classpath.

methods.name: setPermissionsPath
methods.description: Sets the resource location for authorization rules, requiring a non-null resource.
